title: System Explorer native evidence
description: The raw native payload behind one observation, captured fresh at request time. See docs/SPEC.md section 6. This was the last undeclared surface on the wire: capabilities and hub-hosts gained schemas earlier, and evidence carried none at all until the route migration made its shape worth pinning.

interface.description: The native interface the payload came from — a D-Bus name, 'findmnt -J', 'docker-engine-api'. Absent on the error shape, which never reached one.

payload.description: The native reply, verbatim modulo redaction: a D-Bus property map, a parsed JSON document, a sysfs walk. Any shape — the whole point of evidence is that the agent does not translate it.

redacted.description: Paths within the payload whose values were withheld (SPEC section 11, rule 10). Present only when something actually was — an empty list would claim redaction that never happened.

error.description: Why no payload could be captured. An error evidence response still names its object and moment; it carries no interface or payload.
